title: Introduction and overview — Mercedes-Benz SSK (1928-1932)
description: Introduction and overview of the Mercedes-Benz SSK (1928-1932): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Mercedes-Benz SSK, Count Trossi's supercharged monster, was the fastest car of its day at 120 mph — a 7.1-liter supercharged six in a shortened chassis. About 40 were built; SSKs won the Mille Miglia and dominated 1930s racing. The Trossi-bodied SSK is automotive art. Baseline facts: German racer 1928-1932; ~40 built by Mercedes-Benz; fastest car of its day..
